Ok just my honest opinion Guy: from my brief time of talking with you, you seem very sweet and I think could probably get along with a LOT of people and get yourself into an alliance, BUT my worry for you is the early portion. If you aren’t proactive enough, or you’re busy with like work, etc, I think you could potentially go out very early, but I think if you lock in you could do VERY good. I could see you making top 10 for sure, I feel you have the presence to do it, but you have to be smart and maneuver anyway you can, you could get outplayed mid game to early game and you have to make sure to avoid that. Tai: Your strength is your strategic mind and how you look at the game, the only thing is you should not let the others know about this outside of district 11. I think you’re VERY smart, but you also have to manage your perception from others, so take a lot from others, but maybe don’t give them as much back. I think you also have potential to make a DEEP run if you play your cards right, but other than Guy, I think you probably naturally are a bit more threatening just in the way you speak, so I could see you being targeted early to mid portion based off how people view you as a threat. If there’s anyway, you need to make yourself look weaker than you actually are, while also doing the numbers and staying steps ahead behind the scenes. I know you can do it, and YOU know you can do it. Muski: Your strength is 100% just how you speak to people, the social part of your game is excellent and I think you know that. Your problems will probably stem from people thinking you’re too social, or people are worried you’ll make a deep run & may try to kill you. But let me tell you this….JUST because you’re a winner of snack, doesn’t mean you can’t win this. In S1 of hungry games, Maple won that season despite winning S5 of snackvivor. Don’t be scared that you’ll be targeted simply for being a winner. Use it to your advantage, be the kind and super social Muski you are, and deceive everyone else to make your own path. I think you could be in trouble early, but if you can get over that slump and get into a good alliance, I have full faith you can do it (edited)
